plan.notes:
Per the 2026-2027 Texas A&M University undergraduate catalog: Performance and Visual Studies (BA). Prerequisites are not listed in the catalog's plan of study grid; consult course descriptions.
Catalog footnotes:
[grid1 fn1] Must make a grade of C or better on all major coursework.
[grid1 fn2] Select from ARTS 100-499, DCED 100-499, FILM 100-499, MSTC 100-499, MUSC 100-499, PERF 100-499, PVFA 100-499, THEA 100-499, VIST 100-499. 6 hours must be taken at the 300-400 level.
[grid1 fn3] Select from any 100-499 course. 9 hours must be taken at the 300-400 level.
[grid1 fn4] Select from FILM 215/GLST 215 , PERF 156 , PERF 301 , PERF 325 , MUSC 323 , MUSC 324/ANTH 324 , THEA 200
[grid1 fn5] Select from ARTS 149 , ARTS 150 , ARTS 329 , ARTS 330 , ARTS 341 , ARTS 343 , ARTS 345 , ARTS 349 , ARTS 350 , COMM 360 , DCED 201 , FILM 299 , MUSC 224 , MUSC 225 , MUSC 226 , MSTC 150 , PERF 310 , PERF 311 , PERF 312 , THEA 281 .
